remarks: This exceptional property offers an ideal blend of convenience, comfort, and natural beauty. Perfectly situated, it provides effortless access to a wealth of amenities, while its serene surroundings create an atmosphere of relaxation. This impeccably maintained tri-level townhouse features 2 spacious bedrooms and 1.5 baths, along with a rare attached garage. The sophisticated living space is adorned with hardwood floors throughout, The open-concept dining and living area with sliding doors leading to a private deck, is perfect for both entertaining and quiet enjoyment.  The second level boasts two generously sized bedrooms with ample closet space, complemented by a well-appointed full bath, ensuring both luxury and convenience. The fully finished walk out lower level offers a versatile family room and a private laundry room, providing additional comfort and functionality. Whether lounging by the pool or strolling along the beach, this home offers an unparalleled lifestyle just steps from your door.
